incident-bot: PAGER: P0 - smart-route-v2 fallback loop + cache miss storm detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Error spike -> 5xx (~120/min) and wrong model variants served (clients seeing larger tokens than requested). Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/alerts/1934567890 :rotating_light:

jordan (oncall): I'm oncall, taking. tagging @mike-r and @olivia. Starting triage. :eyes:

pager-duty-bot: Scheduled page to SRE rotation (anya) and runtime lead (mike-r).

anya (sre): joining. Can we get a quick summary of what "wrong variant" means here? Is it full model mismatch or response shaping?

mike-r (runtime): initial read: requests from us-west are being routed to us-east fallback variant (.small) intermittently. Cache lookup keys are variant-scoped but routing inserted a region alias. So cache is returning us-east KV blobs for us-west requests -> mismatched KV context -> decoding errors -> 5xx.

olivia (platform): this started right after a canary of smart-route-v2 that added an aliasing rule for cross-region fallbacks (to prefer cheap variants). The new policy appends an alias token to the routing key -> e.g. `model:my-open-3` became `model:us-east:my-open-3` in some paths. Cache scheme expected `model:my-open-3` only.

jordan (oncall): understood. That explains wrong KV reuse. Impact?

mike-r (runtime): quick numbers: ~8% of requests in us-west hitting fallback loop, 3% error rate baseline -> now ~18% error rate. Latency >5s for many. Customers impacted: 3 enterprise tenants (SLA alerts triggered).

katie (support): support tickets: #CS-4572, #CS-4576 — both report truncated/incomplete outputs. I've posted the status page update and DM'd affected reps.

anya (sre): mitigation plan: 1) stop auto-fallback policy to break the loop 2) evict stale cross-region cache keys 3) force a routing reconfigure to normalize KV prefixes 4) monitor. I'll run 1 and 2 now.

mike-r (runtime): agreed. How to stop policy:

```
# disable auto-fallback for smart-route-v2
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/policies/smart-route-v2/disable-autofallback" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

anya (sre): running disable now...

incident-bot: action: disable_policy(smart-route-v2) -> SUCCESS (1934567921)

anya (sre): next: evict cross-region aliases from the KV layer. Using redis scan + delete on staging keyspace first, then prod.

```
# list keys (dry run)
redis-cli -h kv-cache-prod --scan --pattern "cache:response:model:*:us-east*" | wc -l
# delete (careful)
redis-cli -h kv-cache-prod --scan --pattern "cache:response:model:*:us-east*" | xargs -r redis-cli -h kv-cache-prod del
```

anya (sre): executed evict command at 1934567932. Deletion count: ~42k keys.

mike-r (runtime): forcing routing table refresh to ensure requests compute canonical key without alias.

```
# force routing reload
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/routing/reload?force=true" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

olivia (platform): reload succeeded (1934567940). Observability: starting to see error rate drop for us-west.

jordan (oncall): monitor traces for mis-served tokens. Any customers still seeing 5xx?

mike-r (runtime): a handful (2 customers) still seeing elevated errors — looks like some edge proxies cached the old routing header. I'll invalidate CDN headers for those customers' routes.

```
# purge edge cache for tenant X
adminctl cdn purge --tenant-id tenant-123 --paths "/v1/generate"
```

mike-r (runtime): purge issued at 1934567952.

katie (support): re-checking tickets — CS-4572 updated: "service returning wrong model outputs earlier, now seems stable". I've messaged customers to confirm.

anya (sre): observing 90% of error delta resolved. We should keep policy disabled and create a rollback for the aliasing change.

olivia (platform): agree. Reverting canary and opening rollout-blocker: INC-2026-234. Adding follow-up: update KV keying to include region only in explicit multi-region caches, not appended to the model canonical key.

jordan (oncall): summary for incident channel: cause = smart-route-v2 aliasing introduced region-prefixed KV keys which the cache layer didn't expect -> cross-region KV reuse -> variant mismatch -> 5xx and degraded latency. Mitigations = disabled auto-fallback, evicted aliased keys, forced routing reload, purged edge caches. Customer impact = 3 tenants SLA alerts, 2 tenants brief errors; support and reps notified.

mike-r (runtime): next steps: revert canary, add unit/integration test for key normalization, and instrument a guard on cache lookup that validates region/variant tuple. I'll own the runtime fix.

olivia (platform): I'll own the rollout gating change and update runbook (ADD check: key-scheme-consistency) and schedule a postmortem with product.

katie (support): keeping customers in the loop. Closing active CS tickets as resolved once customers ack.

anya (sre): leaving oncall note and will follow up with a short post-incident Slack message + incident doc. Handing back to oncall (jordan).

jordan (oncall): thanks team. Marking incident as mitigated at 1934567965. Will follow up with timeline and RCA later. :thumbsup:
